print.name: Voron 2.4 PG7 Canbus Rear Exhaust Filter Mod v2
print.description:
Identical to the original model this is based off of, except that the PG7 hole on the side of the housing is fully threaded.

I had the best luck printing with the small opening touching the bed, I know it doesn't make sense based on the direction of the PG7 hole support structure but this is a quick remix, and I may fix that in the future :)  Due to that oddity you will need to use support for the PG7 hole, and could probably benefit from some support on the fan hole bridge.
print.summary: Fixes the original model this is based off, so the PG7 hole on the side of the housing is fully threaded
